objective: Count the total available today units of the Engelbert Strauss e.s.vision e.s. 150-ZC6 Work Top product with garment type polo shirt across all PowerTool branches in Graz.

params.product_sku: Find product_sku from product_variants WHERE brand = 'Engelbert Strauss' AND series = 'e.s.vision' AND model = 'e.s. 150-ZC6 Work Top' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku = product_variants.product_sku AND property_key = 'garment type' AND property_value_text = 'polo shirt')
params.graz_stores: Find store_id from stores WHERE city = 'Graz' AND store_name LIKE '%PowerTool%'
params.total_available: Sum available_today_quantity from store_inventory WHERE store_id IN ($graz_stores) AND product_sku = $product_sku
params.product_record_path: SELECT record_path FROM product_variants WHERE product_sku = $product_sku
params.store_record_paths: SELECT record_path FROM stores WHERE store_id IN ($graz_stores)
